remarks: Welcome to 388 Main St New Canaan! Spacious three bedroom colonial condominium unit on lovely Main Street with views of the Five Mile River from the terrace, master bedroom & lower level. The two unit condominium was enhanced by Carl Kuehner (BLT) in 1987. The complex was further developed with landscaping, a flagstone walk way, stone walls, belgium block perimeters and perennial gardens. The back of the property offers you a bright & sunny outdoor space with extra large deck for three season entertaining. Enjoy central air, and electric heat providing clean & efficient utilities. The lower level has newer hardwood floors, 9 Ft. ceilings and a large window with great views! What a location, Walk on sidewalks to town center and train station. Walk or ride to the local parks including Waveny, Kiwanis, Millpond, Mead and Bristow Sanctuary. Walk or take a quick ride to New Canaan's top rated schools: Community Preschool, South, Saxe, New Canaan High School. Great for commuters: 5 mins to the train, routes 123, 124, 7, and CT-15 Merritt Parkway. Don't miss the opportunity to make this exceptional property your own. Schedule your viewing today!
